subject: Approval needed: multi-stage candidate package for Senior Inference Engineer
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate package approval: Daniel Park (Senior Inference Engineer)

Hi team,

Quick summary and ask — OrbitAI's top candidate (Daniel Park) verbally accepted pending final approval on an expanded package. Recruiter Lucy asked for confirmation today. We need 
1) one-time sign-on adjustment (out-of-band) 
2) an equity refresh offer to bridge a market gap 
3) headcount confirmation that we can exceed the posted band for this hire (this is a UD-approved headcount but exception to comp band)

Proposed package (requested by hiring manager):
- Base: $190,000 (above band midpoint for EMEA/US comparison; role approved to hire at $170–185k band)
- Sign-on: $40,000 (one-time cash, 50% on day 30, 50% on day 180)
- Equity: 0.25% initial grant + 0.10% equity refresh after 12 months (refresh is the primary exception request)
- Relocation stipend: $8,000 (standard)

Business case bullets:
- Candidate has strong infra + LLM model optimization experience; delivered production inference speedups at current employer (OrbitAI) that translate to immediate unit-cost savings on our serving workload.
- Hiring manager projects ~3–4 months to ramp; expected 15–20% improvement in model throughput on key benchmarks.
- Competing offer from a major FAANG at a total comp ~15% higher; sign-on needed to keep momentum.

Attachments: Offer_Summary_OrbitAI.pdf (detailed comp comps), Comp_Comparison_Sr_Inference.xlsx

Request: Marissa/Stephanie — please confirm if finance/comp can approve the sign-on + equity refresh as an exception and whether we can route this as a manager-authorized exception or need exec sign-off. Markus — please advise if you want this escalated for VP approval.

I can be on a quick call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Recruiting Partner, Engineering Hiring
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Candidate package approval: Daniel Park (Senior Inference Engineer)

Naomi — thanks for the note and the clear business case. A few follow-ups before we can approve:

- Please add a short ledger showing OPEX/Headcount impact for Q4/Q1 if we pay the sign-on across two quarters. We need to show where the one-time cash comes from (hiring pool vs discretionary).
- On the equity refresh: comp typically reserves refreshes for 18 months post-hire unless there is a retention-risk argument. Can you include a short retention rationale for the 12-month refresh?
- Headcount: HR has the UD-approved headcount; confirm the job code and whether this will displace any planned hires this quarter.

If the answers are solid I can route as a comp exception to Markus for final sign-off — he will likely want a short note on ROI.

Also cc'ing Stephanie for tax/vesting implications on the 0.10% refresh.

—Marissa
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
